mapper.sql: user_id AS userId, naver_email AS naverEmail, access_token AS accessToken, access_expires_at AS accessExpiresAt, refresh_token AS refreshToken, linked_at AS linkedAt, last_sent_at AS lastSentAt, sent_count AS sentCount
mapper.select: SELECT c.user_id AS userId, c.naver_email AS naverEmail, c.access_token AS accessToken, c.access_expires_at AS accessExpiresAt, c.refresh_token AS refreshToken, c.linked_at AS linkedAt, c.last_sent_at AS lastSentAt, c.sent_count AS sentCount FROM user_naver_calendar c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_naver_calendar (user_id, naver_email, access_token, access_expires_at, refresh_token, linked_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{naverEmail}, #{accessToken}, #{accessExpiresAt}, #{refreshToken}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE naver_email = VALUES(naver_email), access_token = VALUES(access_token), access_expires_at = VALUES(access_expires_at), refresh_token = VALUES(refresh_token), linked_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE user_naver_calendar SET access_token = #{accessToken}, access_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{expiresIn} SECOND) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
